intent_snapshot.goal: Implement Slice S2 of Initiative user-acceptance-scenarios: imm-tracker publish-initiative accepts optional per-Task scenarios, renders a 'User scenarios' section on the Child and a derived listing on the Parent, and rejects the whole batch before any remote write when a scenario is malformed or names an acceptance ID its TaskIntent lacks. A publication without scenarios renders byte-identical bodies; terminal projection, TaskIntent schema, and Kernel authority are unchanged.

acceptance.assertion: Per T4 and invariants I3 and I4 of docs/specs/user-acceptance-scenarios.spec.md (source: #186 D4, D7, D9, D10): given Tasks that supply scenarios, the Child body has '## User scenarios' after '## Acceptance criteria' with one item per own scenario showing its ID, mode, mapped acceptance IDs, and Actor, Given, When, Then, a manual scenario as an unchecked task-list item with its reason and an automated one as a plain bullet; and the Parent body has '## User scenarios' after '## Testing strategy' with one plain bullet per scenario of every Task showing its ID, owning Slice ID, mode, When, and Then (positive). A Child that supplies no scenario renders no such heading even when a sibling does (negative). When no Task supplies scenarios the Parent and every Child body are byte-identical to the bodies rendered without this feature; mark-terminal with phase done on a Child whose manual scenario box was ticked closes it as completed and preserves the tick; and an amendment leaves every historical Child's bytes untouched while a bound pending Child's scenarios update with its brief (bound).

Per T5 of docs/specs/user-acceptance-scenarios.spec.md (source: #186 D8, D11): a batch whose scenarios are a valid mix of automated and manual entries publishes (positive). It performs zero mutating remote calls and returns its existing structured failure, naming Task and scenario or acceptance ID, for a scenario that lacks a required field, has an id not matching BR-SCN-<n> or SCN-<n>, repeats an id within the Initiative, is automated with no acceptance ID, names an acceptance ID absent from its TaskIntent, or is manual without manual_reason (negative). A manual scenario naming no acceptance ID is accepted; scenario text obeys the existing public-projection text rules and bounds (bound). Every rendered scenario list item starts at line start, with no metadata comment before the bullet or task-list marker (positive). Each Child's ownership marker block carries one <!-- immune-brain:scenarios=<percent-encoded JSON> --> per Task, holding all its scenarios verbatim; manual_reason is required in manual mode, validated whenever supplied, and retained for either mode; an amendment reads each historical Child's scenarios only from its marker: a Child carrying no scenarios marker has no historical scenarios and its bytes are never rewritten; when a marker is present there must be exactly one with a complete frame, validated by the same validator as pending scenarios and re-encoding byte for byte equal to the marker, and any other state rejects the whole batch before any write (negative). Stored values must also survive re-projection, so a value grown past its bound by escaping, or a restricted-context acceptance ID the pending path accepts, is rejected at publish before any write (negative). Multiline text, Markdown headings, and Markdown bullets in scenario fields are data; a pending scenario repeating any historical ID is rejected before any write (negative).

Per T5 of docs/specs/user-acceptance-scenarios.spec.md (source: #186 D10, D11): the packaged Planner contract's Initiative Carrier Preference section and docs/agents/issue-tracker.md describe the optional per-Task scenarios input, its automated and manual modes, and that omitting it renders no section (positive); the text states scenarios are public projection that never widens TaskIntent scope or authority (negative); and the existing carrier-gate contract assertions are unchanged (bound).

findings.summary: plugins/immune-brain/runtime/github_issue_tracker.ts:1209–1217 的 approvedAmendmentContent 仅从 pending Tasks 重建 Parent scenarios，导致 amendment 删除历史 Child 的 Parent 场景条目。应保留 approved baseline 中历史 Slice 的场景条目，再合并 pending 场景，并在约定测试 seam 覆盖历史 Child 原本含有场景的 amendment。

evidence.trigger: 首次发布时 Task A 含 SCN-1、Task B 仍 pending；A 完成后，将 A 的精确 body 声明为 amendment.historical，仅在 input.tasks 提供 B 的更新。parent.scenarios 只包含 B 的场景，createInitiativeBody 重建 Parent，publishAmendmentDirect 将其写回。A 的 Child 保留 SCN-1，但 Parent 丢失该条目；若 B 没有场景，整个 User scenarios section 被删除。tests/github-initiative-recovery.test.ts:943 的新增测试从无场景的历史 Child 开始，无法发现此缺口。

findings.summary: plugins/immune-brain/runtime/github_issue_tracker.ts:1852 的 seenScenarioIds 只覆盖当前 pending batch，amendment 可重复使用历史 Child 已拥有的 scenario ID，违反 Initiative 内唯一性并发生远端写入。应在写入前将已绑定历史场景 ID 纳入唯一性校验，并在 tests/github-issue-projection-contract.test.ts 增加历史与 pending ID 冲突时零 mutation 的断言。

evidence.trigger: 已发布且完成的 Task A 拥有 SCN-1；amendment.historical 提供 A 的精确绑定，input.tasks 中 pending Task B 又提供 SCN-1，且映射到 B 的合法 canonical acceptance。preflightPublication 创建空 seenScenarioIds，只遍历 input.tasks，normalizeTaskScenarios 接受 B 的 SCN-1；后续 amendment 校验不检查历史 scenario ID，因而更新 Parent 和 B，留下两个 Child 拥有同一 ID。

findings.summary: 历史 scenario 的渲染与解析不满足无损往返：github_issue_tracker.ts:1036-1040 按行解析并使用贪婪捕获，会把 manual_reason 并入 Then；合法多行字段则导致后续 amendment 被拒绝。应使历史 listing 的提取完整保留允许的文本，并在 tests/github-initiative-recovery.test.ts 补充 manual 和多行历史 scenario 的 amendment 覆盖。

evidence.trigger: 同一 invariant class：历史 scenario 投影的无损保留。先发布合法 manual scenario，then='The result is visible'、manual_reason='Human judgment is required'；Child 渲染出 'Then: The result is visible. Reason: Human judgment is required.'。该 Child 关闭并作为 historical binding 参与 amendment 时，1038 行的贪婪 (.*) 将 Then 捕获为 'The result is visible. Reason: Human judgment is required'，1253-1263 行据此重建 Parent，改变原 scenario 的 Then。另一合法输入 given='First condition\nSecond condition' 可通过 publicText/projectionText 并发布，但成为 historical Child 后，1036 行 split('\n') 使其无法匹配解析表达式，preflight 返回 malformed User scenarios entry，阻断有效 pending amendment。现有历史测试仅使用单行 automated 条目，未覆盖这一往返 invariant。

findings.summary: tests/github-initiative-recovery.test.ts:1009、1047 使用不存在的 gh.mutations 验证零远端写入，实际比较的是 undefined 与 undefined，因此即使拒绝前发生写入，该断言仍会通过。应改用 RecoveryGh 已在 transport boundary 计数的 writeCalls。

evidence.trigger: 执行新增的历史场景 ID 重用拒绝测试。RecoveryGh 在 tests/github-initiative-recovery.test.ts:111 定义 writeCalls，并在 :161-164 对每个 mutating call 增加计数；该类没有 mutations 属性。新增测试却将 gh.mutations 保存为 writes，再断言 gh.mutations 等于 writes，所以无论实际写入次数如何，零写入断言均为 undefined === undefined，无法证明该 negative control。

findings.summary: plugins/immune-brain/runtime/github_issue_tracker.ts:1061–1065：historicalScenarioListings 在读取 scenario-end marker 前按 Markdown 标题截断合法多行 scenario，导致后续 amendment 被拒绝。应先完整读取 marker 界定的条目，仅在条目外识别 section 边界，并在 tests/github-initiative-recovery.test.ts 补充真实发布后转为 historical 的回归测试。

evidence.trigger: 先正常发布一个合法 manual scenario：id=BR-SCN-7、actor=Reviewer、given="First condition\n## Verification\nSecond condition"、when="They inspect the Child"、then="The result is visible"、manual_reason="Human judgment is required"；随后将其 Child 关闭，并以精确历史 binding 对另一个 pending Child 执行 amendment。projectionText 接受该 given，但 historicalScenarioListings 第1061行把字段中的 ## Verification 当成 section 结束，丢掉后面的 When、Then 和编码 markers；第1078行返回 malformed entry，preflightPublication 因而拒绝合法 amendment。违反的是合法 public scenario 文本在历史回读中完整保留的 invariant class：当前 marker 处理发生在 section/entry 正则截断之后，因此不能覆盖标题分隔符碰撞。tests/github-initiative-recovery.test.ts:1052 的多行测试只使用 ## Setup，未触发 parser 特判的 Verification、Out of scope、Slices 标题。

findings.summary: plugins/immune-brain/runtime/github_issue_tracker.ts:1061-1084 的历史场景解析会合并混合格式的相邻条目，遗漏场景 ID，导致 amendment 接受 Initiative 内重复 ID，并生成错误的 Parent listing。应逐条解析并保留每个条目的身份；在现有 recovery 测试中补充复用第二个历史 ID 的零写入断言，以及两个历史条目各自保留 When/Then 的断言。

evidence.trigger: 不变量类别：历史场景集合的完整性与 Initiative 范围内 ID 唯一性。tests/github-initiative-recovery.test.ts:1005 已提供具体输入：历史 Child 先包含无 scenario-end marker 的 SCN-1，随后包含带 marker 的 SCN-2。只要 body 含有一个 marker，1062 行正则就从 SCN-1 开始跨越 SCN-2，直到后者的 marker 才结束；1070 行取得 SCN-1 的 ID，1075-1076 行却取得 SCN-2 的 When/Then，因此结果只保留 SCN-1。将同一测试的 pending scenario.id 从 SCN-1 改为 SCN-2，seenScenarioIds 就无法发现重复，amendment 可以继续写入。现有 marker 方案解决了单条多行文本的边界，但未覆盖混合条目格式下完整保留场景集合这一类别；现有测试只复用第一个 ID，未覆盖被合并丢失的第二个 ID。
